title: 49GAION Operating Protocol - Work Item
description: Every hand-off between units is one Work Item (Protocol §4). Aligned in vocabulary with the A2A v1.0 Task (Protocol §12).

id.description: Unique ID of the Work Item in the shared queue.

sender.description: Sending AIOC, for example [ORG]AIOC-SL. Opened by its Chief of Staff.

receiver.description: Receiving AIOC. First owner is its Chief of Staff.

requested_output.description: What is wanted, in the receiver's declared format (from its card).

acceptance_test.description: How the output will be judged done and the input judged fit; reference (ID + version) or full criteria.

status.$comment: The one shared status list ; kept equal to status.schema.json by tests/cards/check_cards.py.
status.description: A2A mapping: received=TASK_STATE_SUBMITTED, in-progress=TASK_STATE_WORKING, needs-input=TASK_STATE_INPUT_REQUIRED, done=TASK_STATE_COMPLETED, rejected=TASK_STATE_REJECTED.

owner.description: Exactly one node at a time; null only when status is done. Only the owner writes.

location.description: Controlling-copy location, for example a repository path at a commit or tag.

bounce_limit.description: The bounce limit set in the [ORG]AION's Configuration.

stopped.description: true when the stop rule fired; the item then goes, with its full history, to the [ORG]HOAC-ACS seat of the receiving unit; if that seat is empty, to the seat that delegated it (Protocol §4.4).

type.description: design-proposal = an [ORG]HOAC-ACS seat's proposal, correction or critique of the AIs, addressed to OCO (Protocol §4.7).

proposal_answer.description: The answer of OCO, recorded with proposal_reason.

proposal_reason.description: The reason of OCO for its answer.

failing_samples.description: Links to real failing samples; at least one for a critique. When the hub accepts the critique, they join the position's fixed test.

caused_change.description: For an accepted design-proposal: the commit of the design change and the version it replaces.

objection.description: For status objection-open (Protocol §4.7): no AI, including the Chief of Staff of OCO, can close or act on it; only the HOAC seat accountable for OCO decides and closes it.

accountable_human.description: The HOAC seat accountable for OCO (a Configuration setting).

decided_by.description: Must be accountable_human; an AI or bot account is never valid here.

parent_work_item.description: The id of the parent Work Item; required for a sub-work item (an item opened to serve another item); null for a top-level item. Chains must be acyclic (no A->B->A): the protocol check walks the parent links before a sub-item is opened (Protocol §4.6).

chain_depth.description: 0 for a top-level item; the parent's chain_depth + 1 for a sub-work item. The maximum is set by each organisation in its Configuration; the schema sets no cap.

status_entered_at.description: When the item entered its current status; the status's maximum waiting time is counted from here (Protocol §4.6).

wait_escalation.description: reminded = the owner was reminded after the status's maximum waiting time; escalated = still waiting after one more period, raised to the [ORG]HOAC-ACS seat of the receiving unit, or if empty to the seat that delegated it (Protocol §4.6).

reason.description: Required when status is rejected or needs-input, or when stopped is true.

evidence.description: Visible evidence answering each acceptance criterion.

made_from.description: Source IDs and versions the output was made from.
